landingPage.title: Survey Designer
landingPage.description:
Welcome to Survey Designer! This tool allows you to build 
 high-quality, multi-lingual, standardized surveys in a few 
 simple steps. It follows the WFP standard naming conventions 
 (Codebook) while giving you flexibility on what to include in 
 your survey. It allows you to either generate the survey as an 
 XLSForm or to push directly into ODK-based tools such as: MoDa 
 and Kobo.
